title: Useful Compass
description: A Minecraft mod that displays the player coordinates and in game time on the hud.
body:
A Minecraft Fabric mod for version 26.1.2 which displays player coordinates and world time on the hud. Requires the compass and the clock to be in your inventory respectively.
